descriptions.sol33a_land_collision_800bda28: Reads the land-indestructible property; when clear, resets the destruction counter, computes candidate group bits from the motion position and radius, applies collision to selected groups, and posts a position/radius message only when the destruction counter equals one. The mask cursor exists only for a nonempty group range. Partial layouts describe the GC32 reference ABI; portable adaptation and runtime behavior remain unvalidated.
